name: mammal
trans: n. any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair…

name: postpone
trans: v. hold back to a later time

name: woodland
trans: n. land that is covered with trees and shrubs

name: cave
trans: n. a geological formation consisting of an underground enclosure with access from the surface of the ground or from the sea

name: order
trans: n. (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed; a degree in a continuum of size or quantity
v. give instructions to or direct somebody to do something with authority; make a request for something

name: lawyer
trans: n. a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice

name: acid
trans: n. any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt
adj. harsh or corrosive in tone

name: beat
trans: v. come out better in a competition, race, or conflict; give a beating to; subject to a beating, either as a punishment or as an act of aggression
n. a regular route for a sentry or policeman; the rhythmic contraction and expansion of the arteries with each beat of the heart

name: fitness
trans: n. the quality of being suitable; good physical condition; being in shape or in condition

name: necessity
trans: n. the condition of being essential or indispensable; anything indispensable

name: church
trans: n. one of the groups of Christians who have their own beliefs and forms of worship; a place for public (especially Christian) worship

name: flood
trans: n. the rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land; an overwhelming number or amount
v. fill quickly beyond capacity; as with a liquid; cover with liquid, usually water

name: publication
trans: n. a copy of a printed work offered for distribution; the act of issuing printed materials

name: critical
trans: adj. marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws

name: behavior
trans: n. manner of acting or controlling yourself; the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances

name: vote
trans: v. express one's preference for a candidate or for a measure or resolution; cast a vote; express one's choice or preference by vote
n. a choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative; the opinion of a group as determined by voting

name: session
trans: n. a meeting for execution of a group's functions; the time during which a school holds classes

name: crop
trans: n. the yield from plants in a single growing season
v. cut short

name: technique
trans: n. a practical method or art applied to some particular task; skillfulness in the command of fundamentals deriving from practice and familiarity

name: entrant
trans: n. a commodity that enters competition with established merchandise

name: overload
trans: v. become overloaded; fill to excess so that function is impaired
n. an electrical load that exceeds the available electrical power

name: council
trans: n. a body serving in an administrative capacity

name: chairman
trans: n. the officer who presides at the meetings of an organization

name: railway
trans: n. line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight

name: contract
trans: n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
v. enter into a contractual arrangement; engage by written agreement

name: rare
trans: adj. not widely known; especially valued for its uncommonness; recurring only at long intervals

name: common room
trans: n. a sitting room (usually at school or university)

name: enquiry
trans: n. an instance of questioning

name: thick
trans: adj. not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions
n. the location of something surrounded by other things

name: liquid
trans: adj. existing as or having characteristics of a liquid; especially tending to flow; filled or brimming with tears
n. a substance that is liquid at room temperature and pressure

name: dye
trans: v. color with dye

name: rat
trans: n. any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse

name: measure
trans: v. determine the measurements of something or somebody, take measurements of; express as a number or measure or quantity
n. any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal; how much there is or how many there are of something that you can quantify
